description: This file defines a class 'DeletedMessages' that manages a collection of deleted message keys, stored in local storage with a session-specific key. It provides methods for checking, deleting, restoring, and clearing message keys, with persistence handled via local storage.

classes.name: DeletedMessages
classes.description: Manages a set of deleted message keys, stored in local storage under a session-specific key, with methods to check, delete, restore, and clear messages.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the DeletedMessages instance with a session key and loads existing deleted keys from local storage.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a message key is marked as deleted.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks a message key as deleted and persists the change.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Removes a message key from the deleted set, effectively restoring it.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads deleted message keys from local storage into the internal set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the current set of deleted message keys into local storage.
